Well-equipped place, good products, reasonable prices, very helpful and attentive. Mary was kind, patient, and (very rarely) respectful of requests dictated by health and fear needs, doing an excellent job. Excellent service, palpable love for dogs. I definitely recommend her.
Valentina is serious and professional, absolutely highly recommended

Bring my French Bulldog Mia, Valentina as well as being a friend and a professional follows courses and treats the puppies with a lot of love and care, my dog's fur stays white for weeks and remains very fragrant and when we leave the shop my dog ​​is always relaxed and calm, and trust me she is a devil at home but every time we give her a bath she always comes out calm and peaceful
The best groomer in town, Valentina has an immense love for animals, she has demonstrated great professionalism, 5 well-deserved stars

Excellent experience! The girls were so kind, making me available on a Saturday afternoon at short notice, saving me time for an important event. They listened to my needs and those of my dog, making him even more beautiful than usual!

Well done… I've been around a bit and I think I'll come back and never change!

Perfect staff, super welcoming, kind, and helpful girls. I went there with an urgent laundry need and they were there right away. You can tell they're passionate about what they do. I highly recommend it ❤️

Exceptional experience! My toy Maltese is very difficult to handle—he's nervous and often aggressive—but the girls were incredibly patient and professional. They managed to handle my dog's constant agitation. A truly top-notch center, I highly recommend it.
Thanks 🙂 …

Fantastic professional grooming. My experience (and Betty's, haha) was excellent from the start. The staff was helpful and knowledgeable, and asked what treatments they could and couldn't perform due to the dog's specific conditions. I only mentioned a previous history of dermatitis, and they proceeded to use a gentle shampoo specifically for the dog. Gland drainage, ear cleaning, nail trimming, and Betty, especially, was happy at the end of it all, not stressed or tense like she has been with other groomers.
I recommend them and will definitely be back! 😊

For me, 0. The cut was unfair, not even, and the beautiful fur of a Maltese dog, who was carefully combed every day and has long, silky fur, was damaged. I had asked for a bath and a trim of the ends. Never again.
I was very happy with how Snoopy was treated, as he's usually a bit reluctant. However, I was pleasantly surprised by his professionalism and skill. I recommend him 👍🏻 …

I want to point out that this is my first time here.
I had the pleasure of meeting the owner and her father, two very sweet people who are so passionate about their work. I have two small dogs, one of whom is a pug, who rarely lets her nails be trimmed. The owner in question succeeded with so much love and patience. She even gave us two bow ties and gave us some treats, because our dogs don't eat kibble.
We did a test run and noticed that my husband and I loved them. We even got a loyalty card because we really appreciated this woman's professionalism.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
See you next time.
Very professional, helpful, and kind. We've tried several groomers, but this is the best! Affordable prices. Highly recommended!
Very helpful shop, very kind and professional staff. I recommend it.
